events.title: Sub-Harmonic Transformer Thermal Stabilization Under Evening EV Charging
events.media_headline: Regional Grid Alert: Neighborhood Substation Transformers Overheating as Evening EV Fast-Charging Collides with Rooftop Inverter Harmonics
events.solver_human: Dr. Ananya Rao (Control Systems & Power Electronics Engineer)
events.implementation_summary: Deterministic 20ms sliding-window notch controller with 14-deg bank phase stagger
events.core_mechanism_headline: When identical EV inverters share one transformer inductance, their phase-locked loops synchronize like metronomes on a wobbling board. Staggering each inverter bank's virtual impedance at the 5th and 7th harmonic via a 20 ms sliding-window filter cancels 82% of core heating.
actionable_controls: Configure substation edge controller sliding window to 20.0 ms (128 samples @ 6.4 kHz).
Set virtual harmonic impedance Z_h = 0.85 ohm at 300 Hz (5th) and 420 Hz (7th) with 14-degree phase stagger across charger banks A/B.
Verified operational outcome: THD drops from 13.7% -> 3.8%, stabilizing transformer oil at 74.8C.
verified_background_operations: Capability 'CAP-GRID-01' (control_policy): Deterministic 20ms sliding-window notch controller with 14-deg bank phase stagger [Verified: 2341ab1cdccbc617c4f9]
Outcome guarantees proven: total_harmonic_distortion_pct < 4.5; oil_temp_c < 90.0; zero_unstable_control_poles == True
Data stream 'Co-op Substation 10kHz 3-Phase Telemetry Stream (Anonymized)' (14400 records) attested [att-8f41c09e22a7b110]

events.title: Storm-Culvert Vortex Suppression & Flash-Flood Infrastructure Retrofit

events.solver_human: Prof. Marcus Vance (Hydraulic Structures & Fluid Systems Specialist)
events.implementation_summary: Parametric chevron baffle sizing & cavitation-margin verification module
events.core_mechanism_headline: You do not need to rebuild the concrete culvert. Bolting a pair of 24-degree chevron micro-baffles 0.35 diameters upstream of the inlet throat injects counter-rotating vortices that keep the flow attached to the concrete wall.
actionable_controls: Bolt two 10mm steel chevron wedges at 24.0 deg angle, height = 14 cm (0.06D), 84 cm from inlet lip.
Verified operational outcome: peak ceiling suction drops by 64% and standing cavitation pocket is eliminated.

events.title: Root-Zone Soil Salinity Flushing Under 35% Cooperative Drought Water Cut
events.media_headline: Agricultural Basin Report: Rising Capillary Salinity Threatens 180,000 Acres of Smallholder Orchards as Water Allocations Drop 35%
events.tasker_human: Mateo Solis (Smallholder Orchard & Irrigation Co-op Coordinator)
events.solver_human: Dr. Layla Haddad (Vadose-Zone Agronomist & Irrigation Systems Engineer)
events.implementation_summary: Tensiometer-triggered two-stage valve schedule (25m wet / 90m dissolve / 40m flush)
events.core_mechanism_headline: Salt rises during daytime evaporation when micropores stay half-wet. Replacing daily trickle with a pre-dawn dual-pulse—a 25-minute wetting front at 03:30 AM, a 90-minute pause to dissolve salt rims, and a 40-minute gravity flush at 05:00 AM—carries dissolved salt below the roots using 31.5% less water.
actionable_controls: Trigger Pulse 1 at 03:30 AM for 25 min whenever 30cm tensiometer reaches -42 kPa.
Hold valves closed for 90 min so crystallized pore salt dissolves into the wetting front.
Trigger Pulse 2 at 05:00 AM for 40 min. Verified outcome: root-zone EC drops 3.45 -> 1.74 dS/m while saving 31.5% water.

events.title: Polypharmacy Dosing Schedule Optimization to Prevent Morning Orthostatic Falls
events.media_headline: Pharmacovigilance Signal: Unexplained Morning Dizziness & Fall Hospitalizations in Seniors Prescribed Combined Beta-Blocker + SSRI Regimens
events.solver_human: Dr. Samuel Mensah (Clinical Pharmacokineticist & Causal Inference Specialist)
events.implementation_summary: Federated doubly-robust dosing stagger verifier with renal eGFR safety gating
events.core_mechanism_headline: First-pass hepatic CYP2D6 enzyme saturation peaks 90 to 180 minutes after simultaneous oral dosing. Separating the two medications by a 12-hour window (evening vs. morning) prevents peak competitive inhibition, returning active beta-blocker clearance to baseline.
actionable_controls: Safety Gate Check: Confirm patient renal eGFR >= 45 mL/min before applying split-dosing schedule.
Action: Shift SSRI administration to 20:00 and retain metoprolol at 08:00 (12-hour separation).
Verified outcome: mid-morning orthostatic fall hazard ratio drops from 2.41 -> 1.03 (95% CI upper bound 1.14).
verified_background_operations: Capability 'CAP-CARE-05' (causal_diagnostic_model): Federated doubly-robust dosing stagger verifier with renal eGFR safety gating [Verified: 38d2e9218ca6fb095b59]
Data stream 'Federated 14-Clinic Geriatric Orthostatic Vitals Stream (Zero-PHI)' (4200 records) attested [att-77d81a63c902b44e]
